name: fmp_stock_split_calendar
description:
Stock split calendar from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP): symbol, date and split ratio.
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/stock-split-calendar as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): from_date (YYYY-MM-DD), to_date (YYYY-MM-DD); both optional.
Other calendars: fmp_dividend_calendar, fmp_earnings_calendar, fmp_ipo_calendar.
Example: {"from_date": "2025-06-01", "to_date": "2025-12-31"}
